Entries wait for the failure-zone retest verdict or a second low that holds, not for the first green day; the probe fires only on a confirmed Zone 2 close with VIX back below 25, never intraday.

themes.counterRead: The rotation read still holds while credit stays loose: the weakness is concentrated in the handful of names that dominate the index by weight, and the index has not closed below its 200-day average. But the index has now joined the drawdown in size — SPY down 4.67% on the day, QQQ down 6.76% — and SPX sits only 0.42% above its 200-day. If lending standards tighten, HY OAS breaks 4%, or SPX closes below 7,322.74, the rotation read fails and this becomes a rollover. The gap is the signal, not the noise.

NVDA and PLTR carry ACUTE_CATALYST decline reasons, not pure sentiment, so the catalyst must be understood before sizing. A zone print alone is not a bottom call; it is a probe condition, and the close decides it — and this close broke the zone.

themes.counterRead: The election is a real catalyst, not pure sentiment — the Texas outcome changes the merchant-power math, and the price move may be repricing the model itself rather than overshooting it. But the magnitude, 42.5-53.9% off highs against 19-28% revenue growth plus insider buying at the VST trough, says the market has priced the vote as a structural hit before the Nov 6 report has printed. If that report confirms margin or regime damage, the overshoot read dies; if it holds, this is the screened trough to verify, not a chase.

themes.label: Merchant Power: The Texas Vote Is a Real Catalyst

The election event carries 39 matched headlines, the highest signal count in the input.

themes.counterRead: Rates and credit agree the stress is equity-concentrated, not systemic — the bond market is not pricing a credit event. But the stand-down trigger has now fired on the VIX leg: VIX closed 28.18, above 25, so no new probes until VIX closes back below 25. Credit is a lagging confirmer, and the Dec 8-9 FOMC is the dated test of that calm — a hawkish surprise is the path by which calm credit flips.
